segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ שׁוֹר שֶׁהָיָה מִתְכַּוֵּין לַחֲבֵירוֹ, וְהִכָּה אֶת הָאִשָּׁה וְיָצְאוּ יְלָדֶיהָ – פָּטוּר מִדְּמֵי וְלָדוֹת. וְאָדָם שֶׁהָיָה מִתְכַּוֵּין לַחֲבֵירוֹ, וְהִכָּה הָאִשָּׁה וְיָצְאוּ יְלָדֶיהָ – מְשַׁלֵּם דְּמֵי וְלָדוֹת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «an ox that was intending to» gore «another» ox «but struck» a pregnant «woman, and her offspring,» i.e., the fetuses, «emerged» due to miscarriage, the owner of the ox is «exempt from» paying «compensation for» miscarried «offspring. But» in the case of «a person who was intending to» injure «another but struck» a pregnant «woman» instead, «and her offspring emerged» due to miscarriage, «he pays compensation for» miscarried «offspring.»

segments.he: כֵּיצַד מְשַׁלֵּם דְּמֵי וְלָדוֹת? שָׁמִין הָאִשָּׁה כַּמָּה הִיא יָפָה עַד שֶׁלֹּא יָלָדָה, וְכַמָּה הִיא יָפָה מִשֶּׁיָּלָדָה. אָמַר רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל:
segments.en: «How does he pay compensation for» miscarried «offspring,» i.e., how is their value assessed? The court «appraises» the value of «the woman» by calculating «how much she» would be «worth» if sold as a maidservant «before giving birth, and how much she» would be «worth after giving birth.» He then pays the difference in value to the woman’s husband. «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel said:»

segments.he: אִם כֵּן, מִשֶּׁהָאִשֶּׁה יוֹלֶדֶת מַשְׁבַּחַת! אֶלָּא שָׁמִין אֶת הַוְּלָדוֹת כַּמָּה הֵן יָפִין, וְנוֹתֵן לַבַּעַל. וְאִם אֵין לַהּ בַּעַל – נוֹתֵן לְיוֹרְשָׁיו.
segments.en: «If so,» the consequences would be absurd, as «when a woman gives birth» her value «increases. Rather,» the court «appraises how much the offspring are worth, and» the one liable for the damage «gives» that amount «to the husband. And if she does not have a husband,» e.g., her husband died, he «gives» the money «to his heirs.»

segments.he: הָיְתָה שִׁפְחָה וְנִשְׁתַּחְרְרָה, אוֹ גִיּוֹרֶת – פָּטוּר.
segments.en: If the pregnant woman «was» a Canaanite «maidservant and» then «she was emancipated, or a convert,» and she was married to an emancipated Canaanite slave or to a convert who died without any heirs, the one who caused the damage is «exempt» from paying compensation for miscarried offspring. This is because this payment is made specifically to the husband, not to the woman.
